_about: laneOPT5 PerfCpu.cs. DARK: enabled=false means no object is created. skin4 = QualitySettings.skinWeights Unlimited -> FourBones (guarded: refuses/reverts if any skinned mesh has more than maxInfluences per vertex); jobWorkers = JobsUtility.JobWorkerCount (0 = Unity default); vsync0 = vSync off + no target fps, PERF READING ONLY (never in simhash/balance gate runs); stats = periodic [PerfCpu] log line (avg/max ms, gen0 GCs, managed bytes per frame, vsync, refresh). Command line -cpuopt:skin4,jobs=12,vsync0,stats overrides this file (only the listed items on).
